headline: Chemist mixtures, battle effects, and updated build controls.
notes: Added Chemist mixtures: all 60 recipes, flask planning, wiki descriptions, status tooltips and controls for supported ally effects.
Chemist mixture power now uses the Chemist class level and the stat for its mixture type: GUI, DEF, FAI or APT. Unholy Dye uses B + E.
Skills now have Details with wiki descriptions, formulas, rank values, costs and requirements. Damage formulas use the build's referenced stats, weapon ATK and elemental ATK.
Added controls for supported battle effects, with fields for stacks, resource counts and element choices. Each Bard song has one Active toggle for all its bonuses.
Temporary skill stat boosts keep their full value after diminishing returns. Temporary Evade uses the bonus cap; Dodger remains base Evade.
Skill Power bonuses now reach Scaled Weapon ATK. Supported resistance, critical damage and FP bonuses reach the build totals.
Chaos Reflex now shows Max LV by rank. Its Active control shows the Evade bonus from the entered LV.
Added a Spellthief spell library for saved cards and prepared copies, with descriptions, requirements and capacity. Cards use their normal maximum rank.
Moved History into Traits. Only one can be selected, and it is free for Human-category races. History stats count toward trait requirements without changing racial base stats.
Added Crystals beside Level in Identity: +1 HP and FP each, up to 45.
Added Spirits to Talents. White Spirits grant +3 HP and FP each, up to five. Black Spirits are marked TBA.
Crystal, White Spirit and skill input counts are kept in saves, imports and share links.
Simplified Aether's wording, helper text and decorative styling while preserving wiki text. Removed the redundant build note from readout cards.
